title: Mark as No Charge opens its dialog with the line summary and body
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, both at the customer's labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Mark as No Charge".
  4. Click the confirming Mark as No Charge button.
  5. Open the "Category" select.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • A window titled "Mark this line as No Charge?" opens with line 2's title, 1.5 hours, its part, its technician and its current price $180.00 (1.5 h × $120.00).
  • Its text reads "The line stays on this work order and shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours, parts and the story stay; the technician works it like any other line. When the invoice is created, the parts cost of this line posts to the expense account of the category instead of Cost of Parts."
  • It has a required "Category" select, empty, and the buttons "Cancel" and "Mark as No Charge".

Step 4:

  • The mark is refused and "Pick a category" shows under Category.

Step 5:

  • The active No Charge categories are listed.
